name: Pidurangala Rock Viewpoint
description: Pidurangala Rock Viewpoint stands in Matale District, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the surrounding tea plantations and hills. name: Sigiriya viewpoint

It was once part of the Sigiriya fortress complex, constructed by King Kasyapa in the 5th century CE. Today, it serves as a popular spot for tourists to capture photos and appreciate the site's historical and aesthetic beauty.
